findings: Verified: extensions/navigate-tree/frame.ts FrameList.handleInput routes Ctrl-C to cancellation; Escape first clears active search and Escape from list focus cancels. This is an explicit two-stage navigation behavior, not a defect.

Verified: extensions/navigate-tree/index.ts completeRewind validates before branching and attempts to restore the prior leaf on failure; restoration errors are swallowed, so rollback is a potential risk, not a demonstrated defect. retrospective-plan.ts validates complete tool-call batches.
Verified: index.ts buildContextMessages truncates the projected request at a pending instruction and overlays failed or aborted rewind outcomes as isError tool-result clones.

Potential cancellation concern, not verified defect: history-outline.ts patchedInput handles cancellation through the configured tui.select.cancel binding and has no explicit Ctrl-C route; actual behavior depends on host bindings.

Verified: auto-navigate.ts evaluateAutoNavigateTurn forwards AbortSignal to the runner, validates proposed rewind anchors/labels/focus, and returns none for errors or invalid output without mutation. Potential UX gap: cancellation is not distinguished from other errors in its result.

Verified: continuity-capture.ts captureIntent checks abort around classifier work and on abort returns no ops while preserving the watermark. frame.test.ts specifies Escape clearing search before cancellation and Ctrl-C cancellation; these are source assertions, not tests run.

Verified: extensions/navigate-tree/fold-screen.ts dispatches requestFold only after confirmation and fresh anchor/savings/label checks; cancellation/back returns through the wizard rather than prematurely dispatching.

Verified: tree-screen.ts goTo checks idle, confirms, and awaits navigation; cancelled navigation reports no move and errors are caught. Possible race (not verified defect): session state could change between checks and navigation. anchor-command.ts returns to the list on selection cancellation.
